Returns a driver's public profile (first name, last name, phone, photo URL). Used for service calls and display.

item.name: Add Item to Cart (SCRUM-11 / SCRUM-87 / SCRUM-88)

request.description: Returns comprehensive checkout details for the authenticated customer: live cart subtotal, default delivery address, nearest covering store, delivery fee, grand total, estimated delivery time (ETA), supported payment methods, and gift options.

query.description: GUID of the customer address to estimate delivery for

request.description: Calculates delivery fee and estimated delivery time for a specific delivery address. Returns 422 Unprocessable Entity if the address is outside store coverage.

query.description: Filter by OrderStatus (Pending, Confirmed, Preparing, PickedUp, OutForDelivery, Delivered, Cancelled)

request.description: Returns a paginated list of orders placed by the authenticated customer, optionally filtered by status.
Retrieves comprehensive details for an order (line items, payment, address, delivery coordinates, timestamps, and status).

variable.description: GUID of the order to track

request.description: Returns real-time tracking data for a customer order: assigned driver snapshot (name, phone, photo), latest driver GPS location, store and destination coordinates, and estimated arrival time.

variable.description: GUID of the order to confirm

request.description: Customer confirms receipt of their order when status is AwaitingDeliveryConfirmation. Transitions the order status to Delivered.
Initiates a Paymob Card Payment intention and returns the unified checkout session URL (sessionUrl) where the customer completes payment.
Records a Cash on Delivery (COD) payment initiation for an order, setting status to Pending until driver collects payment upon delivery.
Webhook endpoint invoked by Paymob upon transaction status change. Updates the payment status in the database and triggers fulfillment events.
Retrieves paginated list of unassigned pending orders available for drivers to claim. Requires Driver Bearer token.

variable.description: GUID of the order to claim

request.description: Allows the authenticated driver to claim an available order. Transitions order status to Preparing and assigns it to the driver.
Returns the active order currently being fulfilled by the authenticated driver (status PickedUp or OutForDelivery).
Retrieves the history of past orders fulfilled by the authenticated driver, optionally filtered by status.
Retrieves full details (recipient info, delivery address, items, timeline) for an order assigned to the driver.

variable.description: GUID of the order to update

request.description: Transitions the order delivery status. Valid driver transitions: PickedUp, OutForDelivery, AwaitingDeliveryConfirmation, Delivered.
Allows the authenticated driver to report real-time GPS coordinates during order fulfillment. Updates driver location cache and powers customer live order tracking.
